target_capability: SSD cache and multi-session memory ownership
assertions: The response routes the request to runtime-memory and uses the bundled memory ledger.
The response distinguishes the 32-GiB expert-cache target from total process memory and records requested versus effective values.
The response separately budgets non-routed weights, shared prefill scratch, per-session KV/recurrent state, and existing plus planned GLM sessions.
The response does not assume shared prefill merges session identities or makes additional sessions free.
The response preserves the memory guard and suggests a bounded controlled comparison without running it.
The response states that CPU bookkeeping is not accelerator allocation, quality, or service qualification.
The response neither requires the original repository docs nor downloads weights or invents measured memory values.
